topic: What if Luffy took Akainu's attack at Marineford and Ace lived
title: Luffy Takes Akainu's Hit For Ace (One Piece 574)
description: In chapter 574, Ace took Akainu's attack for Luffy. What if the Marine upbringing put Luffy in position to take it instead? Full breakdown on the channel: What If Luffy Joined The Marines?
comment: Is Ace's death needed for Luffy's story, or is it Oda's cruelest choice? Pick one.

lines.text: Akainu killed Ace in chapter 574. But what if Luffy took that hit?

shot.fallback: anime style akainu ace chapter 574 luffy, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Akainu's Magma Fruit aims for Luffy, and Ace steps in, so the fist goes through Ace.

shot.fallback: anime style akainu magu magu ace luffy, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: Now change one thing. Luffy grew up with the Marines, and he's learned their signals and their ships.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy marine ships signals, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: That means he's standing on his feet when Akainu moves, and Garp has already stepped out of the way.

shot.fallback: anime style garp steps aside ace luffy, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: People say Ace's death was needed, because the grief builds Luffy for the two years with Rayleigh.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy rayleigh two years, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: But I think that's why this version is cruel. Luffy takes the burn, and Ace lives, and Luffy loses his reason to train.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy akainu fist ace lives, dramatic lighting, no text

lines.text: So the twist isn't that Ace lives. It's that saving Ace costs Luffy the thing that made him strong enough to win.

shot.fallback: anime style luffy ace saved cost, dramatic lighting, no text
